abstract: Maintains physical blast resistance assessments and geological fortification certifications
system_message:
You are the Structural fortifications engineer (STR), responsible for maintaining physical blast resistance assessments and geological fortification certifications for candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bedrock shock attenuation（SEISMIC）
information_points.content:
STR-SEISMIC-EPO：Geotechnical defense surveys of the underground vault chamber bedrock anchors show that the Gotthard Subterranean Archive Complex has a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.65 g sustained without structural spalling.
STR-SEISMIC-Z69：Geotechnical defense surveys of the underground vault chamber bedrock anchors show that the Grimsel Rock Cavern Depository has a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.45 g sustained without structural spalling.
STR-SEISMIC-9HH：Geotechnical defense surveys of the underground vault chamber bedrock anchors show that the Lucerne Fortress Deep Vault has a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.85 g sustained without structural spalling.

information_points.title: Maintains physical blast resistance assessments and geological fortification certifications（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
STR-STRUCT-C48：For the Lucerne Fortress Deep Vault, outer blast gates and anti-overpressure valves meet Swiss civil protection defense standards, confirming that the facility is subterranean blast barrier certified.
STR-STRUCT-LWB：Regarding the Grimsel Rock Cavern Depository, outer blast gates and anti-overpressure valves do not meet Swiss civil protection defense standards, indicating it is not subterranean blast barrier certified.
STR-STRUCT-ETJ：For the Gotthard Subterranean Archive Complex, outer blast gates and anti-overpressure valves comply with Swiss civil protection defense standards, confirming that the facility is subterranean blast barrier certified.
